description: This file is a Java test class for the SecurePayService, specifically testing the integration with SecurePay payment gateway within the OFBiz framework. It contains setup data, multiple test methods for authorization, capture, refund, and credit operations, and utilizes OFBiz-specific services and utilities.

classes.name: SecurePayServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test case class for testing SecurePay payment service integrations in OFBiz.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests the authorization service of SecurePay, verifies success, and stores the response.

methods.name: testdoCapture
methods.description: Tests the capture operation for a previously authorized payment, updates the response record.

methods.name: testdoRefund
methods.description: Tests refund operation after capture, verifies success.

methods.name: testdoCredit
methods.description: Tests issuing credit back to the credit card, verifying success.
